## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 31. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke's frame is homecoming and youth. After spreading his wings to fly to College Station for two seasons, Klein is back in the Little Apple to coach at his alma mater; he was on the staff in 2014-15 and again from 2017-23, serving primarily as the QB coach and then OC. Burke calls him one of the best players in the programme's history and says he does seem to be a solid coach, given that he is only 36 and already has this job after Chris Klieman and Bill Snyder, two men who excelled in Manhattan for boosters and bettors. His reservation is about the whole staff rather than the man: with OC Sean Gleeson and DC Jordan Peterson, this is a young staff that will learn and grow together, so bumps in the road are inevitable — and this was just a 6-6 programme last season.
